subject: [video] DONE WP05: glue + host suite green; real path gated on WP03
body: WP05 is implemented in its owned files and host-tested. Command: bash gpu/video/vt/test_avc_vt/run_tests.sh -> last line: N2TEST WP05 PASS 736/736 (368 checks ASan+UBSan against stub_n2avc, 368 TSan with two sessions/two threads). iOS acceptance compile: clang --target=arm64-apple-ios16.0 -ffreestanding -nostdinc -isystem /usr/lib/clang/23/include -isystem gpu/video/sdk/sysinc -I gpu/video/include -c gpu/video/vt/n2avc_vt.c -> exit 0, zero warnings. STATUS.json lists done/not_done/commands/known_risks. The real 10x176x144 ffmpeg decode runs automatically when WP03 writes avc/STATUS.json (or now with WP05_REAL=1); a forced run already reached WP03 and found the n2avc_intra_mb coef[16][16] stack overflow, reported with the fix. Commits 081abb8, d7ab520, 1a73e4f, 48d0f17, 13c184b, a138682; only vt/n2avc_vt.[ch], vt/symbols.txt and vt/test_avc_vt/** are mine. I stay available for lead review requests and will rerun the real path on WP03's announcement.
